- Your branch name starts with one of: feat/, fix/, chore/, docs/, refactor/, test/, perf/, build/, ci/, revert/
See CONTRIBUTING.md for full conventions.
-->

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this change and why? -->

## Type of change

<!-- Check one. This should match the type prefix in the PR title and branch. -->

- [ ] `feat` — new user-facing feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `chore` — maintenance / tooling / housekeeping
- [ ] `docs` — docs-only
- [ ] `refactor` — internal change, no behavior difference
- [ ] `test` — tests added or fixed
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `build` — build system / dependencies
- [ ] `ci` — CI config
- [ ] `revert` — reverts a previous commit

## Verification

<!-- How did you validate this? Tests run, manual repro steps, screenshots, etc. -->

- [ ] Tests pass (`dotnet test` for DFSCleanup, or N/A)
- [ ] Manually exercised the change (describe below)
- [ ] Documentation updated (CONTRIBUTING / READMEs / inline) if user-facing

## Breaking change?

- [ ] Yes — described in the PR body with `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer
- [ ] No
